household.title: Household measurements
household.description: Choose the measurements SLM will use. HAN power and energy used this hour are required. The hourly estimate is optional. EnergyTariff is recommended; equivalent Tibber or other sources can be used. {validation_error}

data_description.han_power_entity: Select instantaneous household HAN power in W or kW.
data_description.tariff_used_entity: Measured energy since the start of this clock hour, in kWh. Use EnergyTariff or Tibber accumulated consumption current hour, for example. Do not choose daily use, a lifetime total or a forecast.
data_description.safety_margin_kwh: Energy reserved from the hourly budget. The default 0.3 kWh allows for measurement delays and changing consumption. A higher margin leaves less room for charging.
data_description.energy_estimate_entity: Estimated total consumption for this clock hour, in kWh. Display only. If omitted, sensor.energy_estimate_this_hour is used when available.

menu_options.planned: Hot water and floor heating – planned

planned.title: Planned features
planned.description: Hot-water tanks and floor heating are not supported yet. Floor heating is planned through Versatile Thermostat. No control is created here. Continue to return.

charging.title: EV charging
charging.description:
Select the first Easee charger and its physical connection. Finish with one charger or add a second.

Before selecting a charger: enable Current (A) and Voltage (V) under Settings → Devices & services → Easee → charger → Entities. Show disabled entities, enable both and wait for measured values. {validation_error}

data_description.electrical_connection: Choose the actual supply and number of wired phases. This does not change the installation. SLM uses measured voltage; choose a charging mode later under Phase selection for three-phase wiring.
data_description.charger_device: Choose the Easee device to control. A clear charger name in HA makes it easier to identify.

second_charger.title: Second Easee charger
second_charger.description: Select one new charger. Only chargers not already added are listed. Existing chargers and settings are retained. SLM supports up to two chargers. Before selecting a charger: enable Current (A) and Voltage (V) under Settings → Devices & services → Easee → charger → Entities. Show disabled entities, enable both and wait for measured values. {validation_error}

data_description.charger_device: Only chargers not already added are listed. The existing charger is retained.
